2.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the perusal of the said transcript would show that there was no threat with regard to the withdrawal of the present complaint as has been agitated on the first date of hearing.

3. Learned APP, on instructions from the Investigating Officer submits that there are serious allegations qua the present applicant and subsequently, Sections 313 and Section 376 of the IPC has been added during the investigation.
